title: Finite representation of sparse Fourier hypotheses
statement: For a natural number $n$, the sparse Fourier hypotheses on $n$ Boolean coordinates form a finite hypothesis representation: each hypothesis has a binary-string encoding, decoding its encoding recovers it, and each hypothesis has an evaluation function together with a natural-number bound specifying the work used to evaluate it at any input.
hypotheses_covered: binary encoding and decoding recover every hypothesis
each hypothesis-input pair has a natural-number evaluation-work value
